title: Yakuza Fiancé: Raise wa Tanin ga Ii
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Yoshino Somei, granddaughter of an Osaka yakuza boss, is sent to Tokyo to live with her arranged fiance Kirishima Miyama, grandson of a Kanto yakuza family. Kirishima is charming on the surface and violently unhinged beneath, and Yoshino, no pushover herself, sets out to outmaneuver him. Their dangerous, push-and-pull relationship plays out amid gang politics and brutal yakuza violence.
life_message: It holds up refusing to be cowed: meeting a dangerous world on your own terms and with your own nerve.
